annotations.title: Get Team's Awards at an Event

description: Retrieve every award won by a specific team at a specific event. Returns award records (name, type, year, recipient list including team key and individual awardee names).

event_key.description: TBA event key combining the season year and event code (e.g., '2023casj' for the 2023 Silicon Valley Regional, '2024txhou' for the 2024 Houston Championship, '2024micmp4' for a Michigan State Championship division). Use get_events or get_events_keys to discover valid event keys for a year.

team_key.description: FRC team key formatted as 'frc' followed by the team number with no leading zeros (e.g., 'frc86', 'frc254', 'frc1114'). Uniquely identifies a FIRST Robotics Competition team on The Blue Alliance.

name: get_team_event_awards
